    relations the response ITSELF draws between those atoms.

    relations.append({"source": 6, "target": 7, "sense": "Cause-Effect", "coupling": "entailment", "strength_band": "strong"})

    # Refutation: These two characterizations of the same grain population cannot both be true, for an absorber defined by the absence of a color signature cannot simultaneously impose a color signature exceeding that of ordinary grains.

    relations.append({"source": 13, "target": 14, "sense": "Alternative", "coupling": "exclusive", "strength_band": "strong"})
